applies_when: learner divides a quadratic through by x

dbe_source.recommendation: Candidates divided throughout by x and lost a root. Never divide an equation through by the variable. Factorise instead.

lesson.concept: When x appears in every term, factorise it out. Do not divide by x. Dividing throws away the root x = 0.
lesson.why: Every quadratic has two roots. If you divide by x, only one survives. The other is 0.

work: Set each factor to zero: x = 0 or x - 6 = 0

learner_message: You divided through by x, which throws away the root x = 0. Factorise instead.
